title: Sordland/Turn07/A_Autocrat_CourtDecision
description: Autocrat path court decision on emergency decree concludes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was eagerly waiting for the decis..."
entries.dialogueText: I was eagerly waiting for the decision of the Supreme Court regarding the Emergency Act. I stood up from my chair and looked out the window in my office.

entries.title: Narrator: "Petr looked at me and then continue..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr looked at me and then continued to stare at the ceiling.

entries.dialogueText: "But maybe this period has lasted too long already..."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern

entries.dialogueText: Suddenly, we heard a knock on the door.

entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly, we heard a knock on the d..."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly, we heard a knock on the door. Lucian came inside and bowed his head slightly.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""The Court has made its decision, s..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Court has made its decision, sir."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern

entries.speaker: Player

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: "There is no alternative either way. However, this decree has really damaged your popularity. If the Court sides with the opposition and pushes for it, they may actually impeach you, sir."

entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, sir. I'll make the necessary calls."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""As you wish, sir. I'll make the ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, sir. I'll make the necessary preparations."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Are we really doing this? We still..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are we really doing this? We still have the intel about him from Orso Hawker too."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That's true. He has proven connect..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's true. He has proven connections to Arcasia and has tried to cover his tracks behind international trips for unknown reasons."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We can justify his arrest. And the..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can justify his arrest. And the decree will allow us to hold him without trial. Antel Rock awaits him if we go through with it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He will pay. Take him down.""
entries.dialogueText: "He will pay. Take him down."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Give the order of his arrest.""
entries.dialogueText: "Give the order of his arrest."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I've changed my mind. Maybe we sho..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've changed my mind. Maybe we shouldn't be so reckless."
entries.menuText: "I've changed my mind. Maybe we shouldn't be so reckless."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""If there's nothing else, let's con..."
entries.dialogueText: "If there's nothing else, let's conclude the meeting."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you gentlemen, I'll see you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you gentlemen, I'll see you later."
entries.menuText: "Thank you gentlemen, I'll see you later."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Before we go... I want to think ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before we go... I want to think about some measures again."
entries.menuText: "Before we go... I want to think about some measures again."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes, sir?""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, sir?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Never mind. Let's just focus the t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Never mind. Let's just focus the task at hand."
entries.menuText: "Never mind. Let's just focus the task at hand."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Have a good day, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Have a good day, sir."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""See you later Anton.""
entries.dialogueText: "See you later Anton."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They left the office."
entries.dialogueText: They left the office.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""If there's nothing else, let's con..."
entries.dialogueText: "If there's nothing else, let's conclude the meeting here."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They readied themselves before the..."
entries.dialogueText: They readied themselves before the door.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Understood. I will be ready.""
entries.dialogueText: "Understood. I will be ready."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""As you wish, sir. I'll make the ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, sir. I'll make the necessary calls."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""This is a big move.""
entries.dialogueText: "This is a big move."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Extending the decree and cooperatin..."
entries.dialogueText: Extending the decree and cooperating with the Old Guard has put me in a very fragile spot, which felt like it could backfire at any moment.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Cooperating with the Old Guard, eve..."
entries.dialogueText: Cooperating with the Old Guard, even for a short time, has put me in a very fragile spot, which felt like it could backfire at any moment.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""So... You expect an actual trial a..."
entries.dialogueText: "So... You expect an actual trial against you?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I can't believe this... You did wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't believe this... You did what they asked."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""It's absurd that they did not prot..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's absurd that they did not protest when you declared the emergency and now they're reviewing a past case."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We can't face a negative outcome f..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't face a negative outcome from the supreme Court..."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Well... I don't know. The emergenc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well... I don't know. The emergency was not very popular before and that fed into the rise of the opposition."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""If the Court decides to side with..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the Court decides to side with the opposition for once... You may lose support from everyone. Including the USP."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""How about the Bludish issue? The e..."
entries.dialogueText: "How about the Bludish issue? The emergency did not really help with the situation in Bergia. It has become even more volatile. The Aschraf anniversary will happen later this year; who knows how that will unfold?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I'm afraid we also contributed to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid we also contributed to the radicalization of the malenyevists on our soil..."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I'm afraid we also contributed to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid we also contributed to the radicalization of the Sordish nationalists..."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Now we can start thinking about wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now we can start thinking about what to do next and how to get out of this hole we put ourselves in. The opposition gained a lot of popularity throughout this process."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'll arrange a cabinet meeting to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll arrange a cabinet meeting to address all the issues and our next steps as soon as possible."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Great. You have my trust, Lucian.""
entries.dialogueText: "Great. You have my trust, Lucian."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The quicker we get together, the b..."
entries.dialogueText: "The quicker we get together, the better."
entries.menuText: "The quicker we get together, the better."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I believe the concerns are overexa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe the concerns are overexaggerated."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""With all due respect, I disagree s..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, I disagree sir. The main demand of the people were to pursue constitutional reforms. Not only we did not follow through with that..."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""...We ended up making powerful ene..."
entries.dialogueText: "...We ended up making powerful enemies. Now if the Supreme Court wants us gone, they could potentially do that very easily."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He fixed his tie."
entries.dialogueText: He fixed his tie.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""They declared the Emergency decree..."
entries.dialogueText: "They declared the Emergency decree illegal and agreed with every complaint of Mr. Ricter regarding your actions being unconstitutional."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""As you wish, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, sir."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's finish the meeting here. I'l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's finish the meeting here. I'll make a short phone call."
entries.menuText: "Let's finish the meeting here. I'll make a short phone call."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They left the room."
entries.dialogueText: They left the room.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Good day to you, Mr. President. Am..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good day to you, Mr. President. Am I interrupting anything?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's okay, Livia. What happened?""
entries.dialogueText: "It's okay, Livia. What happened?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, you are. What is it?""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, you are. What is it?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No. Please come in. Is there a pro..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. Please come in. Is there a problem?"
entries.menuText: "No. Please come in. Is there a problem?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thanks, Livia. You may go now.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks, Livia. You may go now."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Damn Orso...""
entries.dialogueText: "Damn Orso..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yeah. A picture of Tarquin Soll. W..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah. A picture of Tarquin Soll. What a nice present!"
entries.menuText: "Yeah. A picture of Tarquin Soll. What a nice present!"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Victory will be close, huh? Orso's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Victory will be close, huh? Orso's getting ahead of himself."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Hi, Livia.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hi, Livia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She walked up and gave it to me. I..."
entries.dialogueText: She walked up and gave it to me. I immediately started to remove the wrapping to reveal a framed photograph.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This must be some kind of a messag..."
entries.dialogueText: "This must be some kind of a message."
entries.menuText: "This must be some kind of a message."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""The Chief Justice has sent you thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Chief Justice has sent you this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She showed me the wrapped object."
entries.dialogueText: She showed me the wrapped object.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Livia. You can leave it..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Livia. You can leave it on my table."
entries.menuText: "Thank you, Livia. You can leave it on my table."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Really? From Orso Hawker? Bring it..."
entries.dialogueText: "Really? From Orso Hawker? Bring it here."
entries.menuText: "Really? From Orso Hawker? Bring it here."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What is it?""
entries.dialogueText: "What is it?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Noticing Petr on the couch, Livia r..."
entries.dialogueText: Noticing Petr on the couch, Livia reddened slightly. She gave a small wave, which Petr returned.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Livia turned to leave."
entries.dialogueText: Livia turned to leave.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""No, but he's obviously trying to s..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, but he's obviously trying to send you a message. I--"

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""He's obviously trying to send you..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's obviously trying to send you a message, but--"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What do you think?""
entries.dialogueText: "What do you think?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Oh... A nice present.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh... A nice present."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""I don't know... A picture?""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know... A picture?"

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Yes, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, sir."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""I'll just bring it to you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll just bring it to you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Did Orso say anything to you about..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did Orso say anything to you about this?"
entries.menuText: "Did Orso say anything to you about this?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As soon as she left the room, Petr..."
entries.dialogueText: As soon as she left the room, Petr came right next to me and took a look at the photograph.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Mr. Vice President. I'll be leavin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Vice President. I'll be leaving now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned to Livia."
entries.dialogueText: I turned to Livia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was an old black and white photo..."
entries.dialogueText: It was an old black and white photograph of Tarquin Soll posing on a destroyed tank at the Holsord Square. The building behind him had thousands of bullet holes on it. To the side a clearly readable slogan 'Victory is close' written on its walls.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What do you think this means, Livi..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you think this means, Livia?"
entries.menuText: "What do you think this means, Livia?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The date, 14 March 1929 was written..."
entries.dialogueText: The date, 14 March 1929 was written on the corner with a black marker.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No. Orso will pay. I'll involve......"
entries.dialogueText: "No. Orso will pay. I'll involve... a group of *fixers.*"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Sir? What do you have in mind?""
entries.dialogueText: "Sir? What do you have in mind?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He had a worried face."
entries.dialogueText: He had a worried face.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's fine, Lucian. I just need to..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's fine, Lucian. I just need to make a phone call."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I took the phone and called Remus H..."
entries.dialogueText: I took the phone and called Remus Holstron.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a few seconds of ringing, he..."
entries.dialogueText: After a few seconds of ringing, he picked it up.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This is the president speaking.""
entries.dialogueText: "This is the president speaking."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Hi, Mr. Holstron, it's me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hi, Mr. Holstron, it's me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I need you to fix a problem.""
entries.dialogueText: "I need you to fix a problem."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Tell me. What is the issue?""
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me. What is the issue?"

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Oh, Mr. President! How can I help..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, Mr. President! How can I help you?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Can you get rid of Orso Hawker?""
entries.dialogueText: "Can you get rid of Orso Hawker?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I need the Court Justices to be ta..."
entries.dialogueText: "I need the Court Justices to be taught a lesson. I want them to know their place."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""I see. They are stepping on your t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see. They are stepping on your toes. You want them scared off?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. Scare them off by any means n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Scare them off by any means necessary. Convince them."
entries.menuText: "Yes. Scare them off by any means necessary. Convince them."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Threaten them, beat them, do whate..."
entries.dialogueText: "Threaten them, beat them, do whatever you want."
entries.menuText: "Threaten them, beat them, do whatever you want."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No. Maybe we shouldn't be so reckl..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. Maybe we shouldn't be so reckless."
entries.menuText: "No. Maybe we can't be so reckless."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""I don't know if it will work. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know if it will work. But we can try."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Teach them a lesson.""
entries.dialogueText: "Teach them a lesson."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Do you have anything else in mind?""
entries.dialogueText: "Do you have anything else in mind?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No, I've changed my mind. Good day..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, I've changed my mind. Good day to you."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Sure. Have a good day.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sure. Have a good day."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""I see. He stepped on your toes too..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see. He stepped on your toes too. You want him completely *gone*?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""His time has come.""
entries.dialogueText: "His time has come."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. This will teach everyone a le..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. This will teach everyone a lesson."
entries.menuText: "Yes. This will teach everyone a lesson."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Can you do it?""
entries.dialogueText: "Can you do it?"

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""I'll talk to my people. See what I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll talk to my people. See what I can do."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No. I've changed my mind. Maybe we..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. I've changed my mind. Maybe we shouldn't be so reckless."
entries.menuText: "No. I've changed my mind. Maybe we shouldn't be so reckless."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. Make sure it's done.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Make sure it's done."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Are you giving me full approval on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you giving me full approval on this, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""I understand. Next time, call me w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. Next time, call me when you are sure about what to ask for.

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Understood.""
entries.dialogueText: "Understood."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I hung up the phone."
entries.dialogueText: I hung up the phone.
